info.name: Where we are in every astronomical cycle the site tracks, with an explicit statement of whether each number was computed, observed, or is an interval with no live phase

params.name: at
params.description: The instant to evaluate. ISO 8601: a date (2026-06-21), or a date and time with an optional seconds, fraction and either Z or a numeric UTC offset. No offset and no `tz` reads as UTC. Reliable from 1700 to 2200.

params.name: start
params.description: The start of a range query, inclusive. ISO 8601: a date (2026-06-21), or a date and time with an optional seconds, fraction and either Z or a numeric UTC offset. No offset and no `tz` reads as UTC. Reliable from 1700 to 2200.

params.name: end
params.description: The end of a range query. A row landing exactly on `end` IS returned: the window is [start, end]. Every endpoint's rule is published as data under limits.range_boundaries in /v2/conventions. ISO 8601: a date (2026-06-21), or a date and time with an optional seconds, fraction and either Z or a numeric UTC offset. No offset and no `tz` reads as UTC. Reliable from 1700 to 2200.

params.name: step
params.description: Sampling stride for a range query: a number plus a unit, one of min, m (minute), h (hour), d (day), w (week), mo (month) or y (year), for example 1h, 6h or 1d. Resolves to at least 1 minute and at most 1 year. Needs `start`. This is the generic grammar; an endpoint that narrows it documents the narrowing on its own `step` parameter, and /v2/conventions publishes every narrowing under limits.step_grammar.endpoint_policies.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of rows to return from a range query, counted forward from `start`. Mutually exclusive with `end`.

params.name: keys
params.description: A comma-separated list of specific cycle keys to return. Mutually exclusive with `kind`/`family`. Omit for every cycle.

params.name: kind
params.description: Filter cycles by how their current position is known: computed from the ephemeris, observed (a live dataset), a named interval with no live phase, or a discrete state.

params.name: family
params.description: Filter to one cycle family. Mutually exclusive with `keys`.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma-separated optional blocks to include. Omit for the endpoint default set.

params.name: tz
params.description: An IANA time zone name, for example Europe/London or America/Chicago. Numeric offsets and abbreviations are not accepted. Governs how a date-only or offset-free `at`/`start`/`end` is read, and how local instants are rendered when time_format=iso.

params.name: ambiguous
params.description: How to resolve a local time that a clock repeated, such as the return from daylight saving. error refuses with 409 AMBIGUOUS_LOCAL_TIME.

params.name: nonexistent
params.description: How to resolve a local time that never happened, such as inside a spring-forward gap. error refuses with 400 NONEXISTENT_LOCAL_TIME.

params.name: time_format
params.description: How instants are rendered: iso for ISO 8601 strings carrying the effective offset, or unix for integer seconds since the epoch.

params.name: format
params.description: Response representation. Each endpoint serves a subset of json, csv and txt; see that operation's description for the exact list, or GET /v2 for every endpoint's formats array. An unsupported value is 400 BAD_FORMAT with the accepted list in `supported`.

params.name: fields
params.description: Comma-separated dot paths into `data` (for example moon.phase_name,moon.illumination) so only those fields are returned. Up to 64 paths; an array element is addressed by its object key, never by index.

params.name: shape
params.description: nested returns the documented object tree. flat returns one object with dotted keys, format=json only.

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal places for numeric fields.

params.name: pretty
params.description: Whether the JSON body is indented (1) or compact (0). Has no effect on csv or txt.

params.name: verbosity
params.description: full includes prose notes, frame definitions and withheld-field reasons in meta. compact keeps every value and every machine-readable name and drops the prose.

params.name: limit
params.description: See the endpoint description at /api/reference.html.

items.docs: Where we are in every astronomical cycle the site tracks, with an explicit statement of whether each number was computed, observed, or is an interval with no live phase. Formats: json, csv, txt. Example: GET /v2/cycles?at=2026-07-28T21:30:00Z
